about.text_02: Tellen Finance provides accounting, financial advisory and technical accounting support to businesses in the Netherlands.

about.text_04: Specialist support is available for IFRS, Dutch GAAP and US GAAP matters, reporting conversions, consolidation and complex transactions.
about.text_05: Each engagement is scoped around the organisation’s needs, with clear deliverables, transparent fees and direct professional accountability.
about.text_06: Bookkeeping, reconciliations, financial reporting and statutory compliance.
about.text_07: IFRS, Dutch GAAP, US GAAP, reporting conversions and complex accounting matters.
about.text_08: Management reporting, consolidation, FP&A, budgets, forecasts and financial control.
about.text_09: Defined scope, agreed deliverables, transparent fees and a consistent point of contact.
